question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: different_quantity

items.text: Edward Jones's continued ability to compete and adapt may be adversely impacted by generational wealth transfer, including changing client expectations and changing client demographics, preferences and values.
items.quote: The Partnership's continued ability to compete and adapt its business model may be adversely impacted by the evolving financial services industry and generational wealth transfer, including changing client expectations for expanded product offerings and technology needs, and changing client demographics, preferences and values.

items.text: Edward Jones states that its asset outflows are impacted by an aging client base and generational wealth transfers outside the firm.
items.quote: These outflows are impacted by a variety of factors, including, without limitation, an aging client base and generational wealth transfers outside the firm, macroeconomic volatility, inflation and consumer spending.

items.text: Edward Jones's asset outflows relative to the prior-year period reflect elevated outflows influenced by an aging client base and generational wealth transfers outside the firm.
items.quote: The outflows relative to the prior-year period continue an increasing downward trend influenced by several factors, including an aging client base, generational wealth transfers outside the firm, macroeconomic volatility, inflationary pressures, and shifts in consumer spending.

items.text: Edward Jones states its asset outflows are impacted by an aging client base and generational wealth transfers outside the firm, with the net new asset decrease attributable to existing clients.
items.quote: These outflows are impacted by a variety of factors, including, without limitation, an aging client base and generational wealth transfers outside the firm, macroeconomic volatility, inflation and consumer spending. The net new asset decrease was attributable to existing clients.

items.text: Edward Jones is pursuing a new digital platform focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors as part of its initiatives to meet clients' needs.
items.quote: a new digital platform, focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.

items.text: Edward Jones addresses strategic risks including generational wealth transfer through initiatives to deliver enhanced value and impact for clients, colleagues and communities.
items.quote: The Partnership seeks to address its strategic risks, most notably competition for clients and personnel in light of the evolving financial services industry and generational wealth transfer, changing client demographics, preferences and values...

items.text: Edward Jones financial advisor attrition increased to 6.4% primarily due to an increase in retirements, consistent with industry trends.
items.quote: Financial advisor attrition increased to 6.4% primarily due to an increase in retirements, consistent with industry trends.

items.text: A financial advisor from North Canton, Ohio left Edward Jones to establish an independent practice through LPL, managing approximately $185 million in client assets at Edward Jones.
items.quote: Nathan J. Hershman, ChFC, CEPA, AAMS, CPWA, CRPC, launched SteadRock Private Wealth targeting families, pre-retirees, retirees, and business owners... Hershman managed approximately $185 million in client assets at Edward Jones, according to LPL's announcement.

cells.differs_because: These are statements about the impact of generational wealth transfer and related preparation efforts, but the sub-question asks for a comparative judgment of which firm is most prepared; the firm's own documents do not state a comparative ranking, only Edward Jones's own exposures and initiatives.
cells.reason: The passages describe Edward Jones's exposure to and preparation for the generational wealth transfer but contain no comparative assessment of which firm is most prepared.
